reference.title: Scenario 3 — Complex Task (3 samples — with prereq, with postreq)
reference.shortdesc: A task can carry supporting information beyond a plain sequence of steps: prerequisites before the

section.p: A task can carry supporting information beyond a plain sequence of steps: prerequisites before the first step, a post requisite after the last step, or both together.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Update the Firmware [Normal]: Complete the following prerequisites: [List Bullet]: Printer is connected to the internet. [List Bullet]: Battery level is above 50%. [List Number]: 1. Open the Settings menu. [List Number]: 2. Select Firmware -> Check for Updates. [List Number]: 3. Follow the on-screen prompts.

entry.codeblock:
Update the Firmware

Complete the following prerequisites:

  • Printer is connected to the internet.
  • Battery level is above 50%.
 Open the Settings menu. Select Firmware > Check for Updates. Follow the on-screen prompts.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Restore Factory Settings [List Number]: 1. Open the Settings menu. [List Number]: 2. Select Reset > Restore Factory Settings. [List Number]: 3. Confirm the reset when prompted. [Normal]: The device restarts automatically and all custom settings are erased.

entry.codeblock:
Restore Factory Settings Open the Settings menu. Select Reset > Restore Factory Settings. Confirm the reset when prompted.

The device restarts automatically and all custom settings are erased.

table.title: Complex task containing both prerequisites and a postrequisite

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Install the Print Driver [Normal]: Complete the following prerequisites: [List Bullet]: Download the driver package from the support site. [List Bullet]: Close all running applications. [List Number]: 1. Run the installer. [List Number]: 2. Accept the license agreement. [List Number]: 3. Restart the computer. [Normal]: The printer is ready to use once the computer restarts.

entry.codeblock:
Install the Print Driver

Complete the following prerequisites:

  • Download the driver package from the support site.
  • Close all running applications.
 Run the installer. Accept the license agreement. Restart the computer.

The printer is ready to use once the computer restarts.

section.p: Result: In all three samples, the task remains a <task> topic with a single <steps> block. Supporting content is routed by its position relative to the numbered list: content before the first step maps to <prereq>, and content after the last step maps to <postreq>, regardless of whether one, the other, or both are present.
